newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Wool prices generally easier at New Zealand sale.
newsitem.headline: Wool prices generally easier at New Zealand sale.

text.p: Wool prices generally eased at the sale in Napier on Wednesday, Wools of New Zealand said.
The market indicator fell six cents to NZ$4.66. The medium segment fell four to $5.01, and the strong segment fell seven to $4.30.
Crossbred fleece 33.7 micron and finer was up to 3.0 percent dearer, 34 micron was up to 1.5 percent cheaper, as was 37 micron and stronger, while 35 and 36 micron was up to 2.5 percent cheaper.
Second shear was generally slightly dearer. Bulky skirtings necks and pieces were unchanged but bellies were 5.0 percent cheaper. Crutchings were fully 2.5 percent dearer.

Main interest came from China, Western Europe and the local mills. The main components were 62 percent crossbred fleece, 18 percent second shear and six percent bulky skirtings. Passings which failed to meet growers' reserves amounted to 11.0 percent of the 1,775 clean tonnes on offer. The next sale will be held at Dunedin on October 24. -- Wellington newsroom 64 4 4734 746
